candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot comparison, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.monthly_change: Arithmetic changes between the rounded February and March snapshots can reflect scope revisions or ingestion timing and are not parcel-level delivery claims or official statistics.
scope_guards.speed_scope: Ofcom broadband-speed protections apply only to participating providers and relevant contracts; actual speed, fault cause and exit rights depend on the customer's service and case facts.
scope_guards.social_scope: Social-tariff prices, benefits, provider participation and geographic availability can change; eligibility must be confirmed with the provider and is not an address-level service-availability claim.
scope_guards.uso_scope: Universal-service eligibility, cost and delivery time require BT or KCOM assessment; the guide does not prove eligibility or availability for a particular premises.
scope_guards.adr_scope: ADR guidance describes complaint-handling routes and eligibility rules; it does not determine the merits or outcome of an individual complaint.
